case.summary: The case was triggered when the system flagged card 15868_0 for possible fraud, leading to an initial block and case creation. Evidence showed the card had numerous transactions with no matching fraud pattern, and the customer confirmed the flagged transaction when asked to validate it. Based on this, the verdict was legitimate, and the final actions allowed the transaction, created a case for record, generated an internal report, and closed the case with no fraud found.
